label: Latest progress prerelease
new: Paint multiple floor or wall cells in one transaction, with a cell count, net price and cancellation before any charge.
Move and sell owned walls while preserving their paid value and refunds; compatible historical doors can use a full-cell opening.
Place furniture by its actual owned footprint and current occupants; an empty service side or future route does not enlarge its physical footprint.
Buying land immediately reveals unowned plots along every connected orthogonal edge, allowing expansion in all four directions.
New parking purchases cost 50,000 coins; previously purchased parking keeps its original ownership and paid-value basis.
Fresh cafes no longer receive a free starter bin. A bin remains an optional 65-coin purchase, with historical entitlements and owned bins retained.
Stoves now use the base cooking speed without upgrade purchases or level bonuses. Valid historical stoves keep their identity, ownership and value.
Waiters can drop dirty dishes at a reachable occupied sink while washing continues, or use another reachable basin when the first is full.
Settings, Help and Updates share compact themed panels, consistent text and accessible close/back controls; Help offers optional live FPS statistics.
The Save button shows saving progress and completion inside the button.
The itch entry offers local play and an embedded Google-account route while keeping local and account progress separate; direct Firebase play remains supported.
fixed: Fixed decoration layers drifting when the camera moves during parcel hover.
Dragged furniture now shows green or red only on its own footprint: valid placement stays green, while overlap or unowned floor is red.
Removed floor-paint validity outlines while preserving the installed material preview and natural tile seams.
Customer entrances must connect to the reachable corridor; an isolated doorway no longer counts as a usable entrance.
Grounded checkout counters and aligned cashier/customer payment contacts with the worktop.
Corrected exterior oak layering so nearby street actors remain visible in front of it.
Staff rings draw above rugs and below solid furniture, with a one-tile inner diameter and the existing rotation and pause behavior.
Restored staff idle-home assignments when recovery replaces the runtime, even when the roster count and model revision are unchanged.
Improved mobile save-choice explanations and comparison-card layout; dragging from Settings buttons scrolls without activating them.
Fixed Update Notes header measurement and information-panel insets so the notes retain their available reading and scrolling space.
The Update Available notice uses the shared theme and a centered desktop layout while retaining mobile safe-area fitting.
Improved continuation of a frozen cloud-save handoff after late or uncertain network completion, without taking a second native snapshot or repeating a confirmed save.
Preserved captured handoff authority for delayed saves, coalesced concurrent owner renewals and kept the ownership lease unchanged when acknowledging a confirmed handoff.
Bounded initial cloud-save, recovery and ownership-start reads; unavailable responses return protected Recovery rather than being treated as an empty save.
Hardened account/page teardown, writer authority and pending-progress protection around cancellation, reload and account changes.
Recovery device labels now stay attached to their exact validated save records, avoiding stale labels from unrelated archived copies.
Timed-out or closed update checks release their owned manifest requests and settle pending confirmation waits.
Ground rendering refreshes after a model replacement; unchanged shop price fonts and checkout work are reused instead of being rebuilt repeatedly.
CrazyGames music downloads can recover from transient failures with bounded retries and cleanup, while keeping the existing audio and preferences.

history.label: Developer preview
fixed: Fixed Google-account handoff acknowledgment when the current device renews its ownership lease.
Fixed account autosaving after the browser journal connection closes or its ownership lease expires while away.
Fixed repeated cloud-save choices while preserving and exporting earlier protected copies.
Refreshed the account/local entry presentation while keeping local and Google-account progress separate.

history.label: Developer preview
fixed: Fixed release validation for hotfix versions while preserving previous update notes and cloud-rollout limitations.

history.label: Developer preview
fixed: Corrected release metadata and atlas dependency binding so the reviewed 0.1.10a fixes can be delivered.

history.label: Developer preview
new: When two different saves need your decision, compare Coins, Last saved and Device before choosing which progress to continue.
Switch to this device explicitly. A connected active game pauses and saves before handing control over.
A new-version notice lets you save and update, or choose Later. Updating waits for cloud confirmation.
fixed: Old cached progress without new changes now loads the latest cloud save automatically.
Unsynced progress stays protected during interrupted connections, device switching and save conflicts.
Improved recovery controls and same-tab continuation after a confirmed update.
Cloud changes remain subject to the coordinated server rollout; an older open tab may need to reopen the current game.
Fixed growing WebGL handle storage during repeated rendering-resource creation and cleanup.
Improved overview camera bounds, input ownership and neighborhood visibility.
When cloud saving is refused, pending progress can be exported before reopening the updated game.

history.label: Developer preview
new: A shorter, skippable tutorial with quick service explanations.
Customers now queue outside when your café is full.
Buy a four-space parking lot for 2,000 coins and welcome customers arriving by car.
More street scenery, passing traffic and bus-stop visitors.
New 60/120 FPS options and a diagnostic log in Settings.
Google-account cloud saves are available as a preview.
fixed: Clearer sign-in and loading guidance.
Improved camera movement, Fit and decorating visibility.
Improved wall, door and window placement, replacement and decoration refunds.
Fixed layering and details for trees, cookware, drink machines and cleaning tools.
Simpler Pause-only controls, with saving status moved into Settings.
More reliable saves, direct cleanup without bin trips, and safer background pause/resume.
This is a developer preview. Cross-device cloud saves and device compatibility are still being verified.
